requested_scope: Owner-authorized C7 source after scoped C6 review; runtime/scientific qualification remains deferred

criteria.rationale: Sixteen scoped requirements map original IMP parents/F70-F73/source to twenty-four planned cases; no original acceptance status changed.
Concrete research-only contracts and restricted native C0/C1/C3 ports exist; authenticated authority, complete actor semantics and all wider contracts remain open.
One ledger, two internal adapters and existing dependencies avoid a generic planner/service/LLM for authority enforcement.
Actor contents remain attributed, reported completion is distinct from effect, generated report lineage is retained, and advice cannot self-authorize.
Count/byte/time/item/disk caps and original prepaid allowances are coded; native-call allocations, hard isolation, physical disk and complete costs remain unqualified.
Durable intent, single-use decisions, policy CAS, fences, report staging and exact candidate retry exist in source; crash/concurrency/recovery/restore cases are unrun.
Existing research-mode architecture and repository patterns justify the finite subset; no new model/dependency/product ranking or mathematical-performance claim is introduced.
Only source/artifact checks and schema generation are permitted here; no product operation, Runtime/store or qualification gate executes.

c6_prerequisite.handoff: C0-carried attributed advice IDs only; no direct C6-C7 interface or authority

findings.title: Boundary ambiguity
findings.detail: Separate modeled actor state/meaning, actual EDI policy, candidate model updates and measured effects.

findings.title: Self-authorizing advice
findings.detail: Separate immutable amendment from local operator decision; expose no operator adoption on the component facade.

findings.title: Authorization staleness
findings.detail: Recheck adoption hash/head/scope/time; sample time after writer lock and retain active-command/policy fences.

findings.title: Duplicate/unknown command completion
findings.detail: Prepay and commit intent first, consume decision once, return original status without redispatch, and require archived-report reconciliation.

findings.title: Receipt starvation after profile changes
findings.detail: Store the original parent completion allowance and bound later receipt writes by it.

findings.title: Generated evidence echo
findings.detail: Archive original report bytes through a restricted C1 facade as generated with command lineage, never raw external evidence.

findings.title: Global actor-state leakage
findings.detail: Expose supplied attributed data only; reject known future cuts and leave C3/C5 full actor semantics unavailable.

findings.title: Repeated access requests
findings.detail: Reuse current grants, normalize exact need keys, retain denial/defer/cooldown and leave actual notifications to C0.

findings.title: Model/adoption confusion
findings.detail: Stage attributed candidate-only C3 puts with no admission, hidden rebase or claimed actual domain adoption.

whole_system_review.ownership: C1 evidence, C3 model/admission, C5 trial state, C6 assessment, C0 workflow, C7 runtime policy remain separate.
whole_system_review.authority: No direct C4/C5/C6 action/adoption bypass; trusted local operator IDs are not authenticated identities.
whole_system_review.feedback: Generated command reports cannot establish independent outcomes; model/advice/adoption/completion/effect stay distinct.
whole_system_review.timing: Pinned cuts/grant intervals/decision expiry plus post-lock clock sample and cooperative fences; UTC/source/perception trust still assumed.
whole_system_review.saturation: Separate lazy stores, finite caps and prepaid completion; C1 recording does not initialize or wait for C7/C3/solver/model.
whole_system_review.recovery: Exact staged command/report/model handoffs with unresolved status; no cross-owner transaction, physical-disk guarantee, external exactly-once effect, restore or HA claim.
